verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a user-initiated bulk operation, such as multi-select editing, batch rescheduling, or batch priority changes across many items. Reclaim's automatic rescheduling, Calendar Sync copying, and default P1 for non-Reclaim events are background automations, not bulk operations. The AI assistant's "preview changes before deploying" never says it acts on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
